test_title: PYST 14: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of :: ?

# : NHP :: RLT : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Given: # : NHP :: RLT : %

Option 1) # = OIQ , % = QLS → OIQ : NHP :: RLT : QLS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04870a0f7c02ad9c959fcfdf2be2a61fa7811520ca870df79378c31c5b158c54.png] 

Option 2) # = OIR , % = QKS → OIR : NHP :: RLT : QKS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34b9fd23e135532c66e772db1578d820c357c481ef8d186631ee858ff34b7a4d.png] 

Option 3) # = OIQ , % = QKS → OIQ : NHP :: RLT : QKS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f21246f3bf92c4b1941a8d83ebecd2b9228ed97e8910b1cd6424dd3ed1d3170.png] 

Option 4) # = OIQ , % = QKR → OIQ : NHP :: RLT : QKR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2ddc9112644705d295284cefdf4dd59f2379862866d03e204f3794bdf11cf6f.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
